description:
NBA legends and former teammates Udonis Haslem and Mike Miller have teamed up to create the most authentic show. Tune in to see these NBA Champions drop weekly insights about what's happening in the league and share their unique perspectives on trending NBA news and sports headlines. And don’t worry, because these two are ready to share entertaining stories from a combined 37 years in the league, off-field interests, and engaging conversations with special guests!

Watch and listen to new episodes every Tuesday & don't forget to check us out on Instagram, Twitter, and TikTok for the best momen
